# GitHub Configuration Files

## Files in this directory:
- **workflows/deploy.yml** - Main CI/CD pipeline for GitHub Pages deployment
- **DEPLOYMENT.md** - Deployment guide and troubleshooting

## Quick Start

1. Push your code to GitHub
2. Go to repository **Settings → Pages**
3. Set Source to "GitHub Actions"
4. Your site will deploy automatically!

## Workflow Features

✅ Automatic build on push to main/master
✅ Turbo-powered monorepo builds
✅ Parallel builds for all microfrontends
✅ Artifact caching for faster deployments
✅ Linting checks (non-blocking)
✅ Pull request previews

## First Deployment

After pushing to GitHub:
1. Check **Actions** tab
2. Watch "Deploy to GitHub Pages" workflow
3. Once complete, find your URL in workflow summary
